blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) continues to advance its commitment to public healthcare by donating mobility aids to beneficiaries in Gloria, Oriental Mindoro during a turnover ceremony held on November 11, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office. The mobility aids were formally turned over by Assistant General Manager for Administrative Sector Julieta Aseo to Mayor Teresita Ong. During the ceremony, Ong expressed her gratitude to the PCSO for its continued support to local communities. She emphasized that the donated mobility aids would significantly benefit senior citizens and persons with disabilities (PWDs) who require assistance with mobility and access to essential […]...
